options.explanation: strong internal determination and energy are the key idea; this makes Drive the clearest choice. - B. goal — is the result someone wants to achieve, not the force that pushes them towards it; the sentence instead points to strong internal determination and energy are the key idea. - C. reward — is a benefit received or expected and may act as an incentive, but it is not motivation itself; the sentence instead points to strong internal determination and energy are the key idea. - D. interest — can motivate someone, but it is only one possible source of motivation; the sentence instead points to strong internal determination and energy are the key idea. - E. discipline — is the ability to keep acting consistently, even when motivation is low; the sentence instead points to strong internal determination and energy are the key idea. - F. energy — is physical or mental capacity and does not itself provide a reason to act; the sentence instead points to strong internal determination and energy are the key idea.

falseSynonyms.zh: 目標不等於 motivation goal 是想達到的結果；motivation 是推動你去追求它的力量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A goal is the destination; motivation is the force.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獎勵不等於 motivation reward 可以成為 incentive，但 reward 本身只是回報。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A reward can motivate, but it is not motivation itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 興趣不等於所有 motivation interest 可以推動行動，但責任、需求、恐懼也可以。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interest is only one possible source of motivation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自律不等於 motivation discipline 是即使沒有動機仍能持續行動的能力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Discipline can operate without motivation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 精力不等於 motivation 有精力不代表有行動理由或意願。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Energy is capacity, not motive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 壓力不等於 motivation pressure 可以推動行動，但也可能降低 motivation。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Pressure is a possible external force.

falseSynonyms.zh: 抱負只在成就導向 sense 接近 ambition 通常與長期成就、地位或成功相關。
詞性陷阱 motivate 是動詞；motivation 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Motivate is the verb; motivation is the noun.
